articles.headline: Shah warns Rahul of ‘crushing defeat’ in 2029
articles.blurb: Union Home Minister Amit Shah dismissed the Opposition’s protests over the SIR and the Election Commission, warning Rahul Gandhi and the I.N.D.I.A. bloc of a crushing defeat in the 2029 polls and saying voters have rejected their narrative.

articles.headline: Oppn will fight till end to restore democracy: Rahul
articles.blurb: Rahul Gandhi told I.N.D.I.A. bloc leaders and student groups in New Delhi that protests at Jantar Mantar would continue until democracy is restored, and said there is no parallel protest elsewhere.

articles.headline: Congress compromised EC by rewarding poll officials: Goyal
articles.blurb: Union Minister Piyush Goyal accused the Congress of undermining Election Commission independence by giving political posts to former chief election commissioners such as T N Seshan and M S Gill.

articles.headline: Capital sees brief calm, but anti-CEC protests persist
articles.blurb: Anti-Chief Election Commissioner protests continued in New Delhi with detentions of groups including NSUI and AIYF supporters despite a brief lull and heavy police deployment.

articles.headline: CJP backs I.N.D.I.A bloc, dismisses rift talk
articles.blurb: Citizens for Justice and Peace leader Abhijit Dipke backed the opposition alliance and denied reports of internal rifts within the I.N.D.I.A. bloc.

articles.headline: HC refuses blanket curb on detentions over CEC protests
articles.blurb: The Bombay High Court declined to issue a blanket order barring police from detaining protesters demonstrating against the Chief Election Commissioner.

articles.headline: Modi holds ‘warm and productive’ talks with Canadian PM
articles.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke by phone with Canadian PM Mark Carney about strengthening bilateral ties, trade and technology; Carney is expected to visit India in December.

articles.headline: Lone MoS from TN resigns from Union Cabinet
articles.blurb: Minister of State L Murugan resigned from the Union Cabinet, citing a wish to focus on party work in Tamil Nadu, stirring speculation of a wider Cabinet reshuffle.

articles.headline: Mundhe denies transfer, says FDA drive to continue
articles.blurb: Maharashtra FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe denied transfer rumours and said his crackdown on adulterated food and drugs would continue.

articles.headline: Godavari-Cauvery interlinking will solve water woes: Naidu after meeting Vijay
articles.blurb: Andhra Pradesh CM N Chandrababu Naidu met Tamil Nadu CM P Vijay in Chennai and said interlinking the Godavari and Cauvery rivers could address long-term water needs of both states.

articles.headline: Gujarat back to bipolar contest as AAP fades in civic polls
articles.blurb: BJP won 38 of 44 seats in the Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation election as the contest reverted largely to BJP versus Congress with AAP’s influence fading.

articles.headline: Siang dam row: Arunachal CM agrees to reduce security
articles.blurb: Arunachal Pradesh CM Pema Khandu agreed to reduce security forces in the Siang Valley and address protesters’ concerns over a proposed hydropower project opposed by the Adi Bane Kebang.

articles.headline: Open to suggestions on removal of LTCG tax, says FM
articles.blurb: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said the government is open to views on removing long-term capital gains tax during budget consultations but did not commit to rate changes; markets rallied with the Sensex gaining over 1,100 points and listed firms adding over ₹4 lakh crore in market cap.

articles.headline: MDR on UPI deferred until after Diwali, says NPCI
articles.blurb: NPCI deferred introducing merchant discount rate on select UPI transactions until after Diwali; a 0.4% MDR had been set to take effect on October 15 following trader-body pressure.

articles.headline: BJP drubs Cong, AAP in Gandhinagar local polls
articles.blurb: BJP won 38 of 44 seats in the Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation election, defeating Congress and AAP.

articles.headline: FlyDubai ‘plot’: 2 Maldivian pilots detained
articles.blurb: UAE police detained two Maldivian FlyDubai pilots over an alleged plot to hijack and crash a Dubai–Tel Aviv flight.

articles.headline: Protesting ryots block highways in N K’taka
articles.blurb: Farmers blocked highways in North Karnataka demanding better sugarcane prices.

articles.headline: Keralam seeks to shield senior citizens with new law
articles.blurb: Kerala introduced the Keralam Senior Citizens’ (Care and Protection of Rights) Bill prescribing up to three years’ jail for mental or physical abuse of the elderly; CM V D Satheesan cited rising crimes and NCRB data showing Kerala cases rising from 1,023 in 2022 to 1,488 in 2024.

articles.headline: TVK govt’s Rs 35/unit power deal sparks political row in TN
articles.blurb: Tamil Nadu’s power utility is buying 3,500 MW at ₹35 per unit to meet peak demand of about 20,618 MW in October 2026, a purchase critics call the costliest in India and costing an estimated ₹504 crore over 16 days at that rate.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu town celebrates Nobel laureate’s ancestral roots
articles.blurb: Vathalagundu in Dindigul celebrated Navanethem “Navi” Pillay’s 2026 Nobel Peace Prize after tracing her ancestors’ migration from Tamil Nadu to South Africa as indentured labourers.

articles.headline: ASSAM GIRL DEATH: Parents’ anguish: ‘Had rly cops acted in time...’
articles.blurb: Family of 22-year-old Himashree Boro, found dead after travelling on the Vivek Express from Guwahati toward Visakhapatnam for a job interview, blamed Railway Protection Force inaction after she called a friend in distress on October 7.

articles.headline: Ladakh integral part of India: MEA
articles.blurb: India hit back after Beijing objected to naming 28 places in Ladakh, with MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal saying Ladakh is an integral part of India and the naming was done in consultation with the UT and local stakeholders.

articles.headline: CM seeks report on police action on anti-SIR protesters
articles.blurb: Chief Minister Siddaramaiah sought a report on police detentions of students and journalists during Bengaluru protests against the Chief Election Commissioner.

articles.headline: Generate question papers at last minute to counter leaks: Nilekani
articles.blurb: Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani suggested generating exam papers at the last minute using technology and AI to reduce paper-leak risks.

articles.headline: Cops to quiz YouTubers after Siddu’s ‘sting-op’ complaints
articles.blurb: Bengaluru police will question YouTube channels including “Karnataka Honey Trap” and “Freedom TV Kannada” over allegedly doctored videos targeting Chief Minister Siddaramaiah.

articles.headline: Udupi gets state's first 'fully literate district' tag
articles.blurb: The state government declared Udupi Karnataka’s first fully literate district with literacy above 95%.

articles.headline: Minister promises to exclude five villages from Byndoor TP
articles.blurb: Municipal Administration Minister H C Balakrishna told protesting farmers that five villages under Byndoor Town Panchayat would be reconstituted as gram panchayats after a 432-day agitation.

articles.headline: Report sought on delay in UGD project in Kundapur
articles.blurb: Balakrishna ordered a report on the 11-year delay in Kundapur’s ₹56.54 crore underground drainage project.

articles.headline: Minister to attend Hydgen Innovation Day event tomorrow
articles.blurb: Large and Medium Industries Minister M B Patil will inaugurate a 20 MW hydrogen manufacturing facility at Ganjimutt on October 15.

articles.headline: DC warns hospitals against denying initial treatment to snakebite victims
articles.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Deputy Commissioner Darshan H V warned hospitals of legal action for denying immediate snakebite care; the district recorded 365 cases in 2023 and 527 through September 2025.

articles.headline: Balakrishna dismisses claims surrounding sting operations
articles.blurb: Minister H C Balakrishna dismissed rumours and media reports about sting operations targeting MLAs.

articles.headline: NSUI accuses ABVP of systematically targeting minority edu institutions
articles.blurb: NSUI alleged ABVP was selectively protesting at minority educational institutions during exam periods.

articles.headline: 'Unrealistic expectations may lead to delusions among Gen Z'
articles.blurb: A Udupi seminar on World Mental Health Day discussed unrealistic expectations and mental health among younger people at G Shankar Government Women’s First Grade College.

articles.headline: BJP MLAs condemn police action against agitating students
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City North MLA Y Bharath Shetty and South MLA Vedavyas Kamath criticised police action against student protesters at St Agnes College.

articles.headline: 'Students must exercise caution while using AI'
articles.blurb: St Aloysius College hosted a lecture on artificial intelligence’s impact on mental health.

articles.headline: Doctors successfully manage high-risk pregnancy
articles.blurb: Kasturba Hospital, Manipal, delivered a baby for a 32-year-old woman with a large aortic aneurysm and uterine fibroids.

articles.headline: Ambulance crew to go on strike again seeking annual increment
articles.blurb: Suvarna Karnataka Arogya Kavacha (108) employees will suspend ambulance services from Wednesday midnight demanding annual increments, a shift system, ₹50 lakh insurance and timely salaries affecting about 3,200 drivers and EMTs.

articles.headline: Minor girl murders grandmother for opposing affair
articles.blurb: Police arrested a 16-year-old girl and her lover Akash for killing her 52-year-old grandmother Mahadevamma in Kr Pet, Mandya, over opposition to their relationship.

articles.headline: Students of B'luru PU college protest cancellation of Dasara holidays
articles.blurb: ABVP students at Presidency PU College’s Hebbal and Yelahanka campuses protested after management cancelled Dasara holidays to finish the syllabus.

articles.headline: 3 youths, riding triple, killed in bike crash
articles.blurb: Rahul Prakash, Sagar Lakkappa and Krishna Gandappa died when their motorcycle hit a bridge pillar near Humnabad in Bidar district.

articles.headline: Sting op row: Ready to provide all documents to HDK, says DKS
articles.blurb: Deputy CM D K Shivakumar said he would furnish all documents to H D Kumaraswamy regarding allegations over a sting operation.

articles.headline: NOT(E)ABLE GARLAND
articles.blurb: Rakshith from Ullal prepared currency-note garlands for Tiger dancers during Navaratri in Dakshina Kannada and Udupi districts.

articles.headline: Malenadu contractors urge govt to settle bills amounting to Rs 1,800 crore
articles.blurb: Contractors in Shivamogga, Chikkamagaluru and Kodagu demanded release of ₹1,800 crore pending for 2022–23 works.

articles.headline: Karnataka to frame policy to promote tourism startups
articles.blurb: Tourism Minister H K Patil said the state will draft a Karnataka Tourism Startup Promotion Policy.

articles.headline: Court bars airing, publishing content against Siddu
articles.blurb: A Bengaluru civil court barred media and social platforms from publishing two videos targeting Chief Minister Siddaramaiah after his suit.

articles.headline: 5.24L added via form 6 against 80.63L excluded from draft rolls
articles.blurb: Karnataka’s SIR tracker figures show 5.24 lakh additions via Form 6 against 80.63 lakh exclusions from draft electoral rolls.

articles.headline: Student drowns in lake
articles.blurb: BCA student Harshashekhar, 20, drowned in Hesaraghatta lake while swimming with friends.

articles.headline: Karwar sizzles at 38 degrees Celsius
articles.blurb: Karwar recorded 38.2°C, its highest October temperature, attributed partly to Super El Niño.

articles.headline: 'Anna Seve' App available statewide from today
articles.blurb: Food Minister Rizwan Arshad launched the Anna Seve app statewide on October 14 so PDS beneficiaries can complete e-KYC, developed with NIC.

articles.headline: DULT to revamp BRTS, plans tram in Hubballi-Dharwad
articles.blurb: Directorate of Urban Land Transport plans to revamp Hubballi-Dharwad BRTS, which carries about 80,000 passengers daily, including studying a tram-train system.

articles.headline: I.N.D.I.A bloc to stick to Jantar Mantar for stir against CEC
articles.blurb: I.N.D.I.A. leaders discussed retaining Jantar Mantar as the protest site while awaiting the Supreme Court’s response on the Centre’s move to denotify the venue.

articles.headline: CM: No double standards on right to protest in B'luru
articles.blurb: Chief Minister Siddaramaiah said Karnataka must uphold democratic protest rights in Bengaluru, referencing police instructions criticised by Minister Priyank Kharge.

articles.headline: India, China spar again over Ladakh
articles.blurb: MEA said India’s statement on Chinese objections to Ladakh place names was self-explanatory amid renewed map-related friction.

articles.headline: Citizens' group slams state govt's 'neglect' of surrendered Naxals
articles.blurb: Citizens’ Initiative for Peace accused Karnataka of neglecting rehabilitation promises for surrendered Naxals including Ravindra, now in NIA custody.

articles.headline: Is freedom to protest confined to Freedom Park?
articles.blurb: Advocates and Congress leaders challenged Bengaluru’s restriction of protests to Freedom Park under a 2021 order, citing a petition involving D K Shivakumar and the 2009 assemblies licensing order.

articles.headline: 'Protest is lifeblood of democracy': Lawyers rally against SIR, CEC
articles.blurb: Hundreds of lawyers from AILAJ and other bodies protested in Bengaluru against Delhi police action on anti-SIR protesters and demanded removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

articles.headline: 'Surprised', cops acted swiftly; protestors flag 'harassment'
articles.blurb: Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh and IG M A Saleem defended minimum force at KR Circle protests while demonstrators alleged harassment.

articles.headline: 'We want free and fair election, not fixed election'
articles.blurb: Cockroach Janta Party and Jagruta Karnataka demonstrated at Freedom Park against SIR and the Chief Election Commissioner.

articles.headline: Farmers' stir holds up traffic on busy Pune-B'luru highway
articles.blurb: KRRS and Hasiru Sene farmers blocked the Pune–Bengaluru highway at Hattargi toll plaza in Belagavi demanding ₹6,000 per tonne for sugarcane.

articles.headline: Shivakumar denies being pushed by Rahul Gandhi during Delhi protest
articles.blurb: Deputy CM D K Shivakumar dismissed BJP claims that Rahul Gandhi pushed him during a Delhi protest.

articles.headline: Policing dissent: Lost in contradiction (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The editorial criticises Bengaluru police action on marchers heading to the Election Commission over SIR roll revision, noting tension between Congress protests in Delhi and curbs in Karnataka.

articles.headline: GST 3.0 bets on ease of process (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The piece argues the 37th GST Council meeting’s reforms emphasise simpler compliance and predictability over rate cuts alone.

articles.headline: A DAWN DEFERRED: Saudi Arabia’s war needs a political exit (Opinion)
articles.blurb: R Swaminathan writes that Saudi-led Operation Dawn of Yemen needs a political exit, weighing Houthi demands against risks of prolonged conflict over Bab el-Mandeb.

articles.headline: RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE: The throne of toes (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Jayanthi Chandrasekaran reflects on getting a professional pedicure.

articles.headline: CJI is right to refuse to meet with politicians (Opinion)
articles.blurb: KV Seetharamaiah, Bengaluru, supports the Chief Justice of India avoiding political meetings to protect judicial independence.

articles.headline: Clear the air (Opinion)
articles.blurb: V Padmanabhan, Bengaluru, urges clarity on sting-operation allegations and political funding in Karnataka.

articles.headline: Instilling accountability (Opinion)
articles.blurb: H V K Bhatta, Bengaluru, backs biometric attendance for degree students to improve accountability.

articles.headline: IN PERSPECTIVE: A legal push for patient autonomy (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Shireen Yachu and Jwalika Balaji discuss legal frameworks for patients to appoint representatives for healthcare decisions when incapacitated, referencing NOTTO.

articles.headline: Without police reform, constitutional freedoms are stillborn (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Vishal R Choradiya argues India needs police reform beyond the 1861 Act and unimplemented National Police Commission recommendations to protect constitutional freedoms.

articles.headline: NASA’s Perseverance rover sets a Mars driving record
articles.blurb: NASA’s Perseverance rover surpassed Opportunity’s off-Earth driving distance while exploring Jezero Crater with advanced self-navigation since its 2021 landing.

articles.headline: End Game. And no more sequels (Opinion)
articles.blurb: S Nanda Kumar recalls meetings with Jeffrey Archer and his popularity in India, including prison diary books.

articles.headline: Urban tenants can now get fair rent fixed (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Our Pages of History notes an October 1976 Karnataka ordinance letting urban tenants seek fair rent fixation.

articles.headline: US strikes with renewed fury (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Our Pages of History recalls October 2001 US airstrikes in Afghanistan after the September 11 attacks.

articles.headline: The grief that stays (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Acharya Prashant’s Oasis column reflects on grief after losing a loved one.

articles.headline: SJM urges Centre to deny Starlink nod
articles.blurb: RSS-affiliated Swadeshi Jagran Manch asked the government to deny Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite broadband entry citing national security and compliance concerns.

articles.headline: UP court to rule in defamation case against Rahul on Oct 26
articles.blurb: A Sultanpur MP/MLA court will pronounce verdict on October 26 in a defamation case against Rahul Gandhi over 2018 remarks about Amit Shah.

articles.headline: Fruit trees, 'honey belt' to line Himalayan railway corridor
articles.blurb: The Rishikesh–Karanprayag rail corridor will be planted with fruit trees and honey-bee-friendly flora as a green corridor supporting local livelihoods.

articles.headline: Upset over mother's remarriage, man flies back from New Zealand, kills stepdad
articles.blurb: Navjot Singh allegedly flew from New Zealand to Uttar Pradesh and shot stepfather Jandeep Singh at a car-wash centre over his mother’s remarriage.

articles.headline: French police hunt for supermarket fridge hackers
articles.blurb: Police investigated a cyberattack on refrigeration systems at about 350 French supermarkets including Carrefour and Monoprix, spoiling food after hackers targeted outdated Danfoss controls.

articles.headline: Saudi-led coalition strikes oil facilities in Yemen
articles.blurb: The Saudi-led coalition bombed Houthi-controlled oil sites near Sanaa as Houthis renewed warnings against flights in Saudi airspace.

articles.headline: Pak successfully test-fires hypersonic missile
articles.blurb: Pakistan test-fired the Fatah-2ER guided rocket system with 400 km range for precision long-range targets.

articles.headline: Thunberg backs French student protests over run-down schools
articles.blurb: Greta Thunberg supported student protests in Saint-Denis near Paris over under-resourced schools.

articles.headline: 6 killed in Pak train accident
articles.blurb: At least six people died when a Peshawar-bound train derailed in Punjab province.

articles.headline: 8 stabbed in South Korean mall
articles.blurb: Police arrested a 59-year-old man after a stabbing spree at a South Korean shopping mall.

articles.headline: Trump defends deal to import Russian diesel
articles.blurb: US President Donald Trump defended importing Russian diesel while saying intelligence sharing with Ukraine would continue.

articles.headline: Quad officials discuss regional resilience, cyber security
articles.blurb: India, Australia, the US and Japan officials met in Singapore on a free and open Indo-Pacific, resilience and cyber security.

articles.headline: UN lauds India's efforts to combat child marriage
articles.blurb: UNICEF representative Praveen Pardeshi praised India’s Beti Bachao Beti Padhao drive against child marriage.

articles.headline: Drones hit ships in Black Sea
articles.blurb: Drone strikes hit vessels in the Black Sea, reports from Sofia said.

articles.headline: Falklands oil: Argentina takes UK to international tribunal
articles.blurb: Argentina took Britain to an international tribunal over Falklands oil exploration.

articles.headline: MI5 chief says Iran targeting UK military sites
articles.blurb: Britain’s MI5 chief warned Iran was targeting UK military sites.

articles.headline: India issues advisory
articles.blurb: India advised nationals in Saudi Arabia to remain calm and vigilant amid regional tensions.

articles.headline: RBI to continue efforts to curb rupee volatility, says FM
articles.blurb: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman told the Bloomberg New Economy Forum 2026 the RBI would curb excessive rupee volatility; the rupee closed at 95.36 to the dollar on October 13 after a 42-paise gain.

articles.headline: Let rupee find its own level, India must focus on innovation: Kotak
articles.blurb: Uday Kotak said at the same forum the rupee should reflect economic strength and India should focus on innovation and self-reliance.

articles.headline: 'AI job-loss fears hogwash, disaster mktg by large capital'
articles.blurb: Nandan Nilekani called fears of AI wiping out Indian IT jobs hogwash, saying AI boosts productivity and millions of small firms will hire.

articles.headline: KIADB to cancel plots over dues
articles.blurb: Industries Minister M B Patil warned KIADB would cancel allotments if industries did not clear dues within a one-month grace period with 10% interest.

articles.headline: K’taka plans IKF offices in five countries
articles.blurb: Karnataka is considering Invest Karnataka Forum offices in the US, Japan, Taiwan, South Korea and France.

articles.headline: AI services may account for almost half of Infy's work in 2-3 yrs: CEO
articles.blurb: Infosys CEO Salil Parekh said AI services are 8% of revenue but could reach 20–50% in a few years; the firm hired 20,000 graduates this year and plans another 20,000 next year.

articles.headline: 'Average PV loan amount up 49% in 7 yrs'
articles.blurb: TransUnion CIBIL data show average passenger-vehicle loans rose to ₹8.2 lakh in H1 2026 from ₹5.5 lakh in H1 2019 with longer tenures.

articles.headline: F2A raises Rs 3k cr for largest growth-stage AI, deeptech fund
articles.blurb: Fundamentum Frontier Advisors raised ₹3,000 crore, anchored by Nandan Nilekani, for AI and deeptech with a ₹3,500 crore hard cap and ₹100–200 crore minimum tickets.

articles.headline: Hyundai Motor Group to invest $15.5 bn in India by 2032
articles.blurb: Hyundai Motor Group chair Euisun Chung discussed with PM Narendra Modi a $15.5 billion India investment plan through 2032 covering EVs, R&D and supply chains.

articles.headline: EPFO extends ECR filing due date to Oct 31
articles.blurb: EPFO extended September 2026 Electronic Challan-cum-Return filing from October 15 to October 31.

articles.headline: Credit is our next big frontier, says Amazon Pay India CEO
articles.blurb: Amazon Pay India CEO Vikas Bansal said expanding credit for consumers and small businesses is the company’s next major focus.

articles.headline: Clash of the super rich clubs
articles.blurb: Manchester City host defending champions PSG in the Champions League on a day that also features Real Madrid in Rome, with Erling Haaland in form amid UEFA financial-rule scrutiny of City.

articles.headline: Australia complete Proteas demolition
articles.blurb: Josh Hazlewood’s 6/49 helped Australia beat South Africa by 214 runs in the first Test in Durban.

articles.headline: Krishan returns as India retain Asiad core for ACT
articles.blurb: Goalkeeper Krishan Bahadur Pathak returns as India named a squad retaining its Asian Games gold-winning core for the Asian Champions Trophy from October 27 in Punjab.

articles.headline: Asiad double medallist Gulveer’s coach suspended
articles.blurb: NADA provisionally suspended distance coach Yunus Khan linked to double Asian Games medallist Gulveer Singh.

articles.headline: Karnataka’s Unnathi stuns top seed
articles.blurb: Unnathi Murlidhar beat top seed Deepthi Venkatesan at the Fenesta Open national tennis championship in New Delhi.

articles.headline: Infantino could pull off ‘Houdini’ act
articles.blurb: Gianni Infantino’s bid for re-election as FIFA president drew commentary from Paris.

articles.headline: India’s Ved bags bronze medal
articles.blurb: Neeraj Phua won bronze at the 13th IBCA World Junior Chess Championship in Greece.

articles.headline: Yuvraj joins Delhi Capitals
articles.blurb: Yuvraj Singh was appointed Delhi Capitals assistant and batting coach for the 2027 IPL season.

articles.headline: Gyan hat-tricks for Wildboar
articles.blurb: Gyan scored a hat-trick in Wildboar’s 5–2 win in a local hockey tournament.

articles.headline: KSFA referee registrations
articles.blurb: Karnataka State Football Association invited fresh referee aspirants to register.

articles.headline: Sindhu, Lakshya fall at the opening hurdle
articles.blurb: P V Sindhu and Lakshya Sen lost opening matches at the Denmark Open.

articles.headline: Record fifth ICC PoM honour for Gill
articles.blurb: India captain Shubman Gill won a fifth ICC Player of the Month award after the West Indies ODI series; Shafali Verma took the women’s award.

articles.headline: India eye series victory
articles.blurb: India leads the West Indies 3–1 in the five-match T20I series ahead of Wednesday’s Hyderabad game with in-form middle order and West Indies threats Sherfane Rutherford and Shai Hope.

articles.headline: Karun wages a lone battle
articles.blurb: Karun Nair’s unbeaten 81 left Karnataka 176/4 in the second innings, trailing Andhra’s declarations at Mangalagiri after Andhra made 274 and 175/4 and Karnataka 120 in the first innings.

articles.headline: Arbash's four powers BFC to 9-0 romp
articles.blurb: Bengaluru FC beat FF-9 9–0 in the KSFA Super Division with Arbash scoring four goals.

articles.headline: Expert panel reviews Chinnaswamy arrangements
articles.blurb: Officials reviewed security and logistics for the October 17 India–West Indies fifth T20I at M Chinnaswamy Stadium.

articles.headline: 1.5 cr bid for ODI WC tkts
articles.blurb: ICC said over 1.5 crore ticket applications were received for the 2027 World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia from October 20 to November 21.

articles.headline: Varun's double ton take Vidarbha to 539 vs K'taka
articles.blurb: Varun’s double century powered Vidarbha to 539 against Karnataka in a CK Nayudu Elite match as Karnataka replied 92/0.

articles.headline: Wildcard Guo stuns Cirstea
articles.blurb: Hanyu Guo upset Sorana Cirstea at the Wuhan Open.

articles.headline: Zverev fights back
articles.blurb: Alexander Zverev beat Alexander Bublik at the Shanghai Masters.
